title: Model package smoke tests
description: Deterministic cases the packager asserts its own model answers correctly. Production replays them against the loaded candidate before activation (ADR 0010); any failure stops the activation with the previous model still serving.

cases.description: At least one case is required: a package that asserts nothing about its own behaviour cannot be smoke-tested, and silently activating it would defeat the purpose of the step.

name.description: Shown to the operator when the case fails, so it must describe the scenario rather than be an opaque index.

features.description: One complete feature record, keyed by the feature names the manifest declares.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance. Floating-point arithmetic differs across platforms and runtime versions, so an exact-equality default would make packages fail for reasons unrelated to model correctness.
